A claim may be set true ONLY after documentary evidence is attached in Claim_Evidence_Tracker.csv and a named corporate reviewer signs off. Templates must never hardcode a claim that has a flag here. As of 2026-11-04 no claim is APPROVED, so every flag ships false.

defence._README: Claims taken from the Defence Logistic Services page currently live on yentransmaritime.com. The capability list itself is published as service scope, which is a description of what the division does. These three are different in kind and are held.

namedNavyClients.text: Naming Algeria, Bangladesh, Egypt, Thailand and Indonesia as navies served
namedNavyClients.evidence: Written permission from each. TP-01 marks client names PROHIBITED without it, and defence customers are the case where that matters most — several of these states may treat a port-visit support relationship as non-public. Being already published on the old site is not consent.

additionalOffices.text: Owned or network offices in Colombo, Malaysia and Lebanon
additionalOffices.evidence: None of the three appear in the OUR REACH locations sheet management supplied on 2026-11-04, which listed India, the UAE, Oman and Houston only. Confirm whether each is an owned office, a network office or an agency relationship, then add it to offices.json with the right role.
